data.name: West & Guns
data.detailed_description:
West & Guns is a fast-paced multiplayer couch game, playable on a single screen or online. Jump into a vibrant spaghetti western world and battle your friends in thrilling gunfights across dynamic arenas. Fight through rapid rounds where a single hit means instant death, until the best shooter claims victory.

Six bullets. One hit, one kill.

Play as iconic western characters and face your friends with revolvers drawn. Manage your six-shot cylinder carefully so you don’t run out of ammo mid-fight, dodge incoming fire with dashes, and use melee kicks to push back opponents or interact with the environment. React quickly, read your opponents, and adapt on the fly.

An unpredictable Wild West

From saloons and deserts to barbershops, sheriff’s offices, and even the rooftops of moving trains, explore lively arenas where the environment can be your greatest ally or your worst enemy.

Interact with the world to trap opponents or trigger unexpected situations. Dynamic events shake up each round, creating unique moments every time you play.

With a clear top-down view, read the action at a glance and use bounces, obstacles, and environmental tricks to gain the upper hand.

Shared screen or online, private games or matchmaking

Play together on a single screen and enjoy local multiplayer sessions with friends in your living room. If there’s not enough room on your couch, go online with them or challenge new opponents through matchmaking.

A spaghetti western experience

Immerse yourself in a world inspired by classic spaghetti westerns, blending dramatic tension with playful humor. Explore a stylized universe where every visual and sound detail enhances immersion. Experience shootouts worthy of the greatest western classics, reimagined with a modern, fast-paced twist.

Unlock a cast of western characters

From iconic cowboys and cowgirls to sheriffs, outlaws, saloon girls, and gold prospectors, unlock a variety of characters with unique styles and traits. Step into their boots and lead them to victory.
